en_title: As Xbox Turns 25, CEO Asha Sharma Says 'A Single Person Will Soon Be Able to Wield Capabilities That Once Required Entire Nations'
cn_title: 值XBOX迎来25周年之际，CEO Asha Sharma表示：「一个人很快就能掌握曾经需要整个国家才能拥有的能力」
opus_summary: XBOX负责人Asha Sharma在品牌25周年前夕展望游戏业未来，称个人和小团队不久将能创造出过去需要大量人力和资源才能完成的作品。她并未明确提及人工智能，但文章认为其愿景暗示了该技术的重要作用，并指出XBOX今年已经历大规模裁员。

paragraphs.en: Xbox chief Asha Sharma has discussed her vision of the video games industry's next 25 years, and suggested its future lies in small teams or individuals able to "wield capabilities that once required entire nations."
paragraphs.cn: XBOX负责人Asha Sharma谈到了她对电子游戏行业未来25年的展望，并表示行业的未来在于能够「掌握曾经需要整个国家才能拥有的能力」的小型团队或个人。

paragraphs.en: Sharma's essay, posted today on X/Twitter ahead of Xbox's quarter century anniversary this weekend, seems to take pains not to explicitly reference A.I. by name. But in a section looking ahead to the future of the Xbox brand and video games in general, the huge role that Sharma apparently believes A.I. will play is made pretty clear.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma的文章于今天发布在X上，恰逢本周末XBOX即将迎来25周年纪念。文章似乎刻意避免直接提及人工智能的名称。但在展望XBOX品牌及电子游戏整体未来的部分，Sharma显然认为人工智能将发挥巨大作用，这一点表露得相当清楚。

paragraphs.en: "While modern games demonstrate the heights of human craft in ways unimaginable just decades ago, the cost, resources, and risk required to create them have grown just as dramatically," Sharma wrote. "As a result, too many ideas never become games, and too many games fall short of what their creators imagined. For decades, this has been the unavoidable trade-off of ambition. We must change this.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma写道：「现代游戏以几十年前无法想象的方式展现了人类技艺所能达到的高度，但制作这些游戏所需的成本、资源和承担的风险也同样大幅增长。因此，太多创意从未变成游戏，太多游戏也未能达到创作者的设想。几十年来，这一直是实现雄心壮志不可避免的代价。我们必须改变这一点。

paragraphs.en: "Throughout human history, the scale of what we could create was determined by the people, capital, and resources we could command. That relationship is beginning to break," Sharma continued. "A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations. A small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars. And our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today's games as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is from its first entry in 1982."
paragraphs.cn: Sharma继续写道：「纵观人类历史，我们能够创造的事物的规模，一直由我们能够调动的人力、资金和资源决定。这种关系正开始被打破。一个人很快就能掌握曾经需要整个国家才能拥有的能力。一支小团队将能够构建如今需要数百名开发者和数亿美元才能打造的世界。而我们规模最大的工作室将能够追求远超当今游戏的宏大目标，正如《微软飞行模拟2024》远超1982年的系列初代作品一样。」

paragraphs.en: It's hard to imagine that this version of the future could be possible without the heavy use of A.I. tools in game development — a topic that is still highly controversial among video game fans, even as it becomes all the more ubiquitous behind the scenes.
paragraphs.cn: 很难想象，如果不在游戏开发中大量使用人工智能工具，这样的未来能够成为现实——尽管人工智能工具在幕后变得越来越普遍，但这一话题在电子游戏玩家中仍然存在很大争议。

paragraphs.en: For industry watchers, though, and also for Xbox employees, Sharma's message also points to something else: a vision of game creation that's far leaner than now in terms of financial cost and human investment. After a another year of brutal layoffs across the video games industry and within Xbox in particular , this concept will likely do little to reassure anyone currently at the games development coalface.
paragraphs.cn: 但对行业观察人士以及XBOX员工而言，Sharma传达的信息还指向了另一件事：一种在资金成本和人力投入方面都比现在精简得多的游戏创作愿景。在电子游戏行业，尤其是XBOX内部又经历了一年的残酷裁员之后，这一构想恐怕难以让目前奋战在游戏开发一线的人感到安心。

paragraphs.en: "I believe the future of gaming will look more like its beginning, when a small team with a big idea could change how the world plays," Sharma concluded. "Our responsibility is to deliver great games, unmistakable hardware, and give more people the chance to make something the world has never seen."
paragraphs.cn: Sharma最后写道：「我相信游戏的未来会更像它的起点，那时一支怀抱宏大创意的小团队就能改变全世界玩游戏的方式。我们的责任是提供优秀的游戏、独具辨识度的硬件，并让更多人有机会创造出世界从未见过的东西。」

paragraphs.en: Sharma oversaw 1,600 job losses within Xbox back in July of this year, and laid out a plan for a further 1,600 employees to be shed over the rest of this year. This led to the company shedding several game developers — small teams — like Double Fine and Ninja Theory and reorganizing beloved studios like id Software this fall.
paragraphs.cn: 今年7月，Sharma主导了XBOX内部1,600个职位的裁撤，并制定了在今年剩余时间内再裁减1,600名员工的计划。这导致该公司在今年秋季剥离了Double Fine和Ninja Theory等几家游戏开发商——小型团队，并重组了id Software等深受喜爱的工作室。

paragraphs.en: The 25th anniversary of Xbox is on Sunday, 15 November.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX的25周年纪念日是11月15日，星期日。
